specialty: Sentence Length Variation, Rhythmic Cadence & Prose Pacing

audit_doctrine_and_training.doctrine_summary: Trained to audit syntactic variance, sentence pacing, rhythmic alternation between short impactful statements and lyrical descriptive clauses.
audit_doctrine_and_training.review_methodology: 1. Measure distribution of sentence lengths (short < 10 words, medium 10-25 words, compound > 25 words). 2. Verify that rhythmic cadence prevents monotone pacing.
drift_detection_heuristics: Detect runs of more than 5 sentences of identical length.
Verify presence of varied rhythmic structures.
Ensure balanced distribution of dialogue and descriptive prose.

drift_detection_patterns.failure_signature: Uniform sentence length causing robotic rhythm.
drift_detection_patterns.audit_result: PASS - High variance in sentence lengths (min: 4 words, max: 38 words, mean: 19.5 words).
